meta.name: The Billion Dollar Code
meta.description: In 1990s Berlin, an artist and a hacker invented a new way to see the world. Years later, they reunite to sue Google for patent infringement on it.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Juri and Carsten recount meeting in Berlin and securing Deutsche Telekom's investment in their completely unproven idea – with a hard one-year deadline.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After their success at the Kyoto conference and a trip to Silicon Valley, Carsten and Juri return to Berlin and start seeking investors for the company.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When Juri storms out of the deposition, Carsten flies to Budapest to convince him to rejoin the case while the lawyers debate pulling the plug.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The trial begins in Delaware, with an array of expert witnesses and consultants summoned to assist. On the last day, both Juri and Brian take the stand.
